programme_name: AusTraits prospective replication of cross-lineage trait-lability rank portability

relationship_to_master_replication.rule: This contract makes the existing optional cross-lineage portability target explicit on the biologically relevant within-family conservative-to-labile rank scale. It does not alter system admission, source, phylogeny, informativeness thresholds, crossed-core construction, provenance rules, or the primary family-context estimand.

discovery_context.interpretation: BIEN suggests a weak S3 trait-ranking tendency but no prune-only robust portability. These BIEN values motivate the replication question and are not themselves prospective evidence for this rank estimand.

question: Does a trait retain its relative position on the conservative-to-labile phylogenetic-memory spectrum when moved to a previously unseen plant family?

estimand.memory_effect: raw memory-loss rho = Spearman(all unordered patristic distances, source-native trait-state dissimilarity)
estimand.within_family_rank: Within each family, rank admitted trait memory-loss rho values using average ranks and rescale as (rank-1)/(m_family-1), so 0 is the most conservative observed trait and 1 the most labile. Families with fewer than two admitted traits are excluded from this secondary test.
estimand.held_out_prediction: For each admitted family x trait observation, predict its within-family rank by the mean normalized rank of that trait across all other admitted families containing the trait.
estimand.direction: positive gain means trait identity improves prediction of relative lability in an unseen family

null_test.scheme: Within each family, permute normalized rank values among the observed trait slots, preserving the final family-trait bipartite graph, trait occurrence counts, family degree, and each family's rank distribution.

axes.mandatory_sensitivity: prune-only on the identical admitted system set

decision_language.robust_rank_portability: gain > 0 and one-sided blocked-permutation p <= 0.05 on both S3 and prune-only
decision_language.backbone_sensitive_rank_tendency: criterion passes on S3 but not prune-only
decision_language.rule: A non-significant test is not evidence that trait identity has exactly zero effect; report gain and null interval on both axes.

descriptive_pair_reversal.statistic: For each trait pair, majority consistency = max(n[A>B], n[A<B]) / (n[A>B]+n[A<B]); summarize the median and fraction >=0.75.
descriptive_pair_reversal.role: descriptive only; cannot change the portability decision

hard_nonclaims: Do not call BIEN rank portability prospective.
Do not alter the master AusTraits primary family-repeatability analysis.
Do not select traits or families using observed AusTraits memory effects.
Do not relax support, semantic, phylogeny, informativeness, degree, provenance, or model-informativeness gates.
Do not infer a universal evolutionary-rate hierarchy from S3 alone.
Do not call a failed prune-only sensitivity proof of zero trait-level ordering.
